mechanism.admissibility: The 499 QI-removal blocks for 2.5 cm WT_FALL coincide exactly with negative mean-theta state margin and are not mass-ledger failures.
mechanism.terminal_width_scaling: QI is a mass-neutral bulk-terminal storage transfer. Per unit storage, terminal mean-theta response is exactly 1/d; 2.5 cm therefore has twice the conversion factor of 5 cm.
mechanism.vector_interference: Exact additive-vector geometry reproduces the sign of QI-removal response on every interval. At 2.5 cm WT_RISE QI and the non-QI remainder are strongly anti-aligned, so QI cancels other local error and removing it worsens shape fidelity.

primary_metric_status: The preregistered unweighted mass-neutral theta RMS remains authoritative for C2/C3/C4E. C4F does not retroactively replace it.

superseded_intermediate_aggregate.reason: The first aggregate compared the full 512-interval C4F WT_FALL ratio with the intentionally 13-interval admissible-only C4E ratio. The immutable case evidence was valid; only the unlike-cohort crosscheck was corrected.
